scan_metadata.scan_scope: packages/ directory (excluding test assets and browser patches)
scan_metadata.notes: Flags are environment variables acting as feature gates in the Playwright source code. PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_* and PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_* configuration env vars were excluded as they are standard documented config options, not feature flags.
